provenance.scope: Current develop preset/profile definitions, not a pinned released firmware binary. Very Long Slow enum remains but has no supported profile or parameter case; excluded from supported sweep. Long Slow deprecated but still selectable and included. Tiny 15.6 kHz label uses 15.625 kHz hardware bandwidth. Sub-GHz modem settings transposed to WiFi-band RF; LORA_24 profiles tested separately. gr-lora_sdr implements conventional LoRa PHY; commercial SX1280 interoperability not established.

playback_clock_calibration.independent_rf_observation: Preamble lag correlation peaks at 1026-1027 samples rather than nominal 1024 at 2 MS/s; diagnostic 399/400 receive resampling recovers both original Short Fast packets. That receive time warp is diagnostic only and is not used to qualify subsequent TX-calibrated results.

scope: Pinned Meshtastic modem preset parameters; conventional LoRa header/FEC/CRC on WiFi-band carrier. Stock gr-lora_sdr decoder, no packet averaging or payload-aided fitting. Commercial hardware and actual mesh interoperability, RF power/range/sensitivity and emission masks remain unqualified.
